setTargetEnable: . Set a target to enable purchase quantities.
littlePartHome: A little part of your home
chooseLocationItem: Choose a location for this item before this stock write can be retried.
chooseTrueHome: Choose what is true at home. Lumio will update the household state.
eligibleOpenedStock: Eligible opened stock is used first. Lumio opens eligible packages only when needed.
lumioChoosesEligible: Lumio chooses the eligible package and batch.
removeActiveInventory: Remove from active Inventory. Stock, batches, and history are retained; active stock actions become unavailable.
stockHistoryRetained: Stock and history are retained. See the saved batches and activity below.
serverSaysFinish: The server says this Finish opened action can be undone.
serverSaysAction: The server says this action can be undone.
serverSaysState: The server says this state change can be undone.
preferenceAffectsFuture: This preference affects future stock writes. Existing batch locations stay as recorded.
useOnlyOne: Use this only when one primary unit equals one complete package. Existing positive unopened stock must be whole packages.
actionAlreadyUndone: This action was already undone. Stock and activity were refreshed.
actionUndone: Action undone. Stock and activity were refreshed.
backupOpenedStockUpdated: Backup opened and current stock updated.
lifecycleSavedRefreshWarning: Saved, but some views could not refresh. Reload to check Inventory and Shopping.
archiveBlockedGuidance: Archive was not saved. Remove this item from each active trip explicitly, then choose Archive again.
lifecycleOutcomeUncertain: The result is uncertain. Reload Item Detail and check history before trying again.
